adm_categories_sub: The work-package and material-group taxonomies. A vendor picks its own categories from this list.
adm_users_sub: Accounts and their roles. A role change is checked by the server itself — the last active admin can never be demoted.
adm_role_vendor_desc: Registers, maintains the company profile and categories, completes applications, uploads documents, signs the declaration, sees status and score.
adm_role_officer_desc: Invites vendors, imports Excel forms, verifies documents, enters 0–3 rubric scores, requests missing information, prepares the evaluation.
adm_role_commission_desc: Reviews evaluations, records the committee decision and justification.
adm_role_manager_desc: Approves prequalification, sets scoring model versions and thresholds, reads market intelligence, makes go/no-go calls.
adm_role_admin_desc: Manages users, integrations, the category taxonomy, scoring model versions and the audit log.
adm_totp_uri_note: Authenticator enrolment URI — shown only now, never retrievable again:
adm_password_unchanged: Leave blank to keep the current password
adm_settings_sub: Matching thresholds, prequalification validity, notification and organisation parameters — data, not code (spec §11.2).
adm_settings_read_only: Read-only — you do not have permission to change these.
adm_group_matching_note: The thresholds project matching and the go/no-go call use (spec §11.1).
adm_group_qualification_note: Validity period, pass mark and the tax-clearance validity window.
adm_group_freshness_note: Staleness windows for financial and headcount indicators.
adm_group_notifications_note: Document expiry reminders and e-mail delivery.
adm_group_organisation_note: Organisation name, default language and currency.
adm_audit_sub: An immutable record of every status change, score edit, decision and integration write (spec §13).
adm_export_note: The export covers only the date range below — the actor, entity and action filters apply to this table only.
adm_cat_sub: Work packages and material groups — what vendor matching is computed against.
adm_usr_sub: Accounts and their roles; permissions are enforced server-side.
adm_set_sub: Matching thresholds, prequalification validity, notifications and language.
adm_aud_sub: Every status change, score edit and decision — an immutable record.
